script: Speaker: Hello everyone, I'd like to tell you about this wonderful acting club I joined recently. The best thing about it is the teacher. We're really lucky to have someone who's actually quite famous. Her name's Alice Fisher and she's appearing in a play at the big theatre in town at the moment. She plays a policewoman in that, but you'll probably know her better as the farmer in the series Green Valley, that was on last year. She's worked as a professional theatre actor for about 10 years. As well as having three years' experience of appearing in serious drama, she's also spent seven years working in comedy productions, so she has lots of different talents. The sessions are always fun and are split into two sections. In the first part, rather than practicing anything to do with movement of the body, we focus instead on improving how to control the voice as an actor. In the second part, we practice our performance skills. If you're interested in coming to the drama club, you'll need to know where to come of course. The club actually hires a room from the university to run the classes. It's much cheaper to do it there than at the college or the acting school. The sessions are on Wednesday evenings. At the moment, we're practicing for a play, which will be on at the town theatre soon. Its name is The Passenger and we're hoping that this latest one will be as popular as the last production the club did, which was called Reality. It was a big success apparently. We've got our last practice for the new play on the 13th of July, with audiences able to come and see it from the 20th of July for one week. Thanks for listening.

items.quote: you'll probably know her better as the farmer in the series Green Valley
items.uz: Alice Fisher hozirda teatrda 'policewoman' rolini o'ynamoqda, lekin u o'tgan yili TV seriyalida 'farmer' (fermer) sifatida tanilgan.

items.quote: she's also spent seven years working in comedy productions
items.uz: U 3 yil dramada ishlagan bo'lsa-da, ko'proq vaqtini (7 yil) 'comedy' (komediya) shoularida o'tkazgan. 'Mostly' so'zi eng ko'p vaqt sarflangan janrni so'raydi.

items.quote: we focus instead on improving how to control the voice as an actor
items.uz: Birinchi qismda tana harakatlari emas, balki 'voice' (ovoz)ni boshqarish mashq qilinadi. 'Rather than' iborasi tana harakatlarini inkor qilish uchun ishlatilgan.

items.quote: The club actually hires a room from the university
items.uz: Klub mashg'ulotlari 'college' yoki 'acting school'da emas, balki 'university' (universitet) binosida bo'lib o'tadi.
Yangi spektaklning nomi 'The Passenger'. 'Reality' esa klubning avvalgi muvaffaqiyatli spektakli bo'lgan, shuning uchun uni adashtirmaslik kerak.

items.quote: audiences able to come and see it from the 20th of July
items.uz: Oxirgi mashg'ulot 13-iyulda bo'ladi, lekin birinchi namoyish (performance) 20-iyulda ('July') boshlanadi.
